name: @ocs/desktop
author: Cipher Workbench contributors
//: There are NO runtime dependencies, and that is the point. Every algorithm in this app is pure ESM (@noble, @scure, @ocs/algos), so tsup inlines the entire main and preload graph and electron-builder ships nothing but the bundle plus the static renderer — no native module, no asarUnpack, no postinstall compile step. @ocs/web is a devDependency that is never imported: it exists so Turborepo orders the web build before build:renderer copies its output. The electron version is pinned exactly because electron-builder downloads binaries for one specific release and refuses a range.
